title: Cancel Dropbox and get 20TB of cloud storage for life for a one-time payment
excerpt: Stop paying rent for your cloud storage.
content_html:
TL;DR: Scramble Cloud gives you 20TB of end-to-end encrypted storage, and a lifetime subscription is on sale for $349.95 (reg. $1,440).

Credit: Scramble Cloud

$349.95
$1,440 Save $1,090.05

Most cloud storage plans charge you every month. Even Google Drive starts asking for money once you run out of the little bit of free space that comes with your account. If you want a better place to keep your files, Scramble Cloud is a new cloud storage platform offering a 20TB lifetime subscription on sale for $349.95 (reg. $1,440).

20TB is a lot of space, enough for computer backups and years of photos and videos, and you don’t have to worry about it disappearing if you ever miss a payment.

Scramble encrypts your files before they leave your device. Not even Scramble can see them, so anything you upload is completely safe and private. You can still share files when you need to. Send a private link, share with a group, or use Team Link to share with people who don’t have a Scramble account.

You can use Scramble in your browser or add it to your computer as a network drive. Once it’s set up, it shows up like any other folder. Word and Excel files open right in the browser, too.

Uploads do have limits. You can upload 70GB a day, and each file can be up to 5GB. A big first backup will take a while, but downloads have no limit.

Scramble works on Windows, Mac, and Linux, and you can open your files in a browser on your phone. If you already have a Scramble account, this plan replaces your current one.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Stop renting your cloud storage. Get a Scramble Cloud 20TB lifetime subscription on sale for $349.95 (reg. $1,440).
